name: builtin-mcp-migration
title: Switch MCP from pi-mcp-adapter to Pi's built-in extension
description: Move the MCP backend from the pi-mcp-adapter package to Pi's built-in MCP extension: drop the adapter, re-enable builtin:mcp, register codebase-memory-mcp in ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json with codemode exposure, and update lib.sh/install-mcp.sh/doctor.sh/.gitignore plus the docs and spec that name the adapter.
creator: tan
